BiblicalUsage: 1) to bend, twist, distort; 1a) (Niphal) to be bent, be bowed down, be twisted, be perverted; 1b) (Piel) to twist, distort; 1c) (Hiphil) to do perversely; 2) to commit iniquity, do wrong, pervert; 2a) (Qal) to do wrong, commit iniquity; 2b) (Hiphil) to commit iniquity
